description: 描述主体为预防、减轻或补救消费者和终端用户重大负面影响而已采取、计划或正在进行的行动。

labels.en: Description of action planned or underway to prevent, mitigate or remediate material negative impacts on consumers and end-users
labels.zh: 预防、减轻或补救消费者和终端用户负面影响的行动

description: 说明主体是否以及如何针对消费者和终端用户的实际重大影响采取提供或促成补救的行动。

labels.en: Description of whether and how action has been taken to provide or enable remedy in relation to an actual material impact
labels.zh: 对实际重大影响提供或促成补救的行动（消费者）

description: 描述以向消费者和终端用户传递积极影响为主要目的的其他举措或流程。

labels.en: Description of additional initiatives or processes with primary purpose of delivering positive impacts for consumers and end-users
labels.zh: 为消费者带来积极影响的其他举措

description: 说明主体如何跟踪和评估行动或举措在改善消费者和终端用户结果方面的有效性。

labels.en: Description of how effectiveness of actions or initiatives in delivering outcomes for consumers and end-users is tracked and assessed
labels.zh: 行动与举措有效性的跟踪评估（消费者）

description: 描述主体针对消费者和终端用户特定实际或潜在重大负面影响确定所需适当行动的流程。

labels.en: Description of approach to identifying what action is needed and appropriate in response to particular actual or potential material negative impact on  consumers and end-users
labels.zh: 确定所需行动的流程（消费者）

description: 描述主体针对消费者和终端用户特定重大影响采取行动的方法。

labels.en: Description of approach to taking action in relation to specific material impacts on consumers and end-users
labels.zh: 针对消费者重大影响的行为方法

description: 描述主体如何确保在消费者和终端用户发生重大负面影响时，补救流程可得、可实施且结果有效。

labels.en: Description of approach to ensuring that processes to provide or enable remedy in event of material negative impacts on  consumers and end-users are available and effective in their implementation and outcomes
labels.zh: 确保消费者补救流程可用有效的机制

description: 描述为缓解因对消费者和终端用户的影响和依赖所产生的重大风险而计划或正在进行的行动，以及有效性跟踪方式。

labels.en: Description of what action is planned or underway to mitigate material risks arising from impacts and dependencies on consumers and end-users and how effectiveness is tracked
labels.zh: 缓解消费者重大风险的行动

description: 描述为把握与消费者和终端用户相关的重大机遇而计划或正在进行的行动。

labels.en: Description of what action is planned or underway to pursue material opportunities in relation to consumers and end-users
labels.zh: 把握消费者相关重大机遇的行动

description: 说明主体如何确保自身实践不会造成或促成对消费者和终端用户的重大负面影响。

labels.en: Disclosure of whether and how it is ensured that own practices do not cause or contribute to material negative impacts on consumers and end-users
labels.zh: 确保自身实践不造成消费者负面影响的机制

description: 披露与消费者和终端用户相关的严重人权问题和事件，包括类型、地点和处置情况。

labels.en: Disclosure of severe human rights issues and incidents connected to consumers and/or end-users
labels.zh: 与消费者和终端用户相关的严重人权问题与事件

description: 披露为管理消费者和终端用户重大影响所分配的资源，包括人员、预算和管理层投入。

labels.en: Disclosure of resources allocated to management of material impacts
labels.zh: 管理消费者重大影响的资源分配

description: 说明主体是否以及如何利用与相关业务关系的杠杆来管理影响消费者和终端用户的重大负面影响。

labels.en: Disclosure of whether and how undertaking seeks to use leverage with relevant business relationships to manage material negative impacts affecting  consumers and end-users
labels.zh: 利用业务关系杠杆管理消费者负面影响

description: 说明主体参与行业或多利益相关方倡议的情况，以及其自身参与如何针对消费者重大影响发挥作用。

labels.en: Disclosure of how participation in industry or multi-stakeholder initiative and undertaking's own involvement is aiming to address material impacts
labels.zh: 行业或多利益相关方倡议中的参与与作用（消费者）

description: 说明消费者和终端用户是否以及如何在项目或流程的设计与实施决策中发挥作用。

labels.en: Disclosure of how consumers and end-users play role in decisions regarding design and implementation of programmes or processes
labels.zh: 消费者在项目设计与实施中的参与

description: 提供面向消费者和终端用户的项目或流程的预期或已实现积极结果信息。

labels.en: Information about intended or achieved positive outcomes of programmes or processes for consumers and end-users
labels.zh: 面向消费者的项目预期或已实现结果

description: 说明以积极影响消费者和终端用户为主要目的的项目或流程是否同时支持实现一项或多项可持续发展目标。

labels.en: Initiatives or processes whose primary aim is to deliver positive impacts for consumers and/or end-users are designed also to support achievement of one or more of Sustainable Development Goals
labels.zh: 项目与可持续发展目标的衔接（消费者）

description: 描述参与消费者和终端用户影响管理的内部职能，以及这些职能所采取的行动类型。

labels.en: Description of internal functions that are involved in managing impacts and types of action taken by internal functions to address negative and advance positive impacts
labels.zh: 参与影响管理的内部职能及行动类型（消费者）
